                       B.Tech Computer Science & Engineering | Machine Learning / Deep Learning Aspirant

      Bengaluru, India | +91 98765 43210 | arjun.mehta@example.com | github.com/arjunmehta | linkedin.com/in/arjunmehta


SUMMARY
Computer Science undergraduate focused on Machine Learning, Deep Learning, and efficient AI systems. Hands-on experience
with Python, NumPy, Pandas, scikit-learn, PyTorch, SQL, and C++. Interested in model optimization, computer vision, NLP, ML
systems, and GPU-accelerated computing. Enjoys building end-to-end ML projects and understanding algorithms from both
mathematical and systems perspectives.

EDUCATION
 B.Tech in Computer Science & Engineering                                                             2025 – 2029
 National Institute of Technology, India                                                              CGPA: 8.72 / 10

TECHNICAL SKILLS
 Programming                   Python, C++, SQL, Bash
 ML / Data                     NumPy, Pandas, scikit-learn, Matplotlib, Feature Engineering, Model Evaluation
 Deep Learning                 PyTorch, Neural Networks, CNNs, Transformers, Transfer Learning
 ML Systems                    Model Compression, Quantization, Inference Optimization, ONNX, FastAPI
 Tools / Platforms             Git, GitHub, Linux, Docker, Jupyter, VS Code
 Cloud / GPU                   CUDA fundamentals, GPU computing, AWS basics
 Concepts                      Linear Algebra, Probability, Calculus, Optimization, Data Structures & Algorithms

PROJECTS
Efficient Image Classification with Quantized CNNs | Python, PyTorch, scikit-learn, ONNX
 • Built and trained a CNN image classifier and evaluated accuracy, precision, recall, and inference latency.

 • Applied post-training INT8 quantization and compared model size and CPU inference performance against the FP32 baseline.

 • Exported the optimized model to ONNX and created a lightweight inference API for deployment.

Resume-to-Skill Intelligence System | Python, FastAPI, NLP, React, Node.js
 • Developed a resume analysis pipeline that extracts technical skills and maps them to a structured student profile.

 • Implemented skill normalization and evidence-aware matching to distinguish confirmed, developing, and missing skills.

 • Built a web interface for comparing current skills against target-role and job-description requirements.

Transformer Text Classification from Scratch | Python, PyTorch, NumPy
 • Implemented tokenization, embeddings, self-attention, positional encoding, and transformer encoder blocks.

 • Trained the model on a text classification dataset and analyzed the impact of sequence length and model depth.

 • Documented experiments covering loss curves, validation accuracy, and common failure cases.

EXPERIENCE / RESEARCH EXPOSURE

 • Studying efficient deep learning with emphasis on model compression, quantization, pruning, and hardware-aw
